latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Video Editing with Facebook" skill.

- Enables editing and exporting Facebook-ready videos from common formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB.
- Cloud-based GPU rendering delivers 1080p MP4 output within 1-2 minutes.
- Provides automatic session and token setup with seamless onboarding and brief notifications.
- Supports easy editing via natural language instructions—trimming, captions, formatting, and more.
- Includes robust error handling, credit tracking, and workflow tips for a smooth editing experience.
